title: Classic Solitaire
description: Play classic Klondike solitaire on green felt with drag and drop, tap-to-move, undo, a timer and old-school scoring. Free in your browser, on desktop and mobile.
about:
Classic Solitaire brings back the Klondike game many of us first played on a desktop computer: seven tableau columns, a stock pile that deals one card at a time, and four foundations to fill from Ace to King. The green felt table, the move counter and the running clock all feel familiar, so you can jump straight in.

Cards resize to fill your screen, whether you play on a large monitor, a tablet or a phone held upright or sideways. Drag cards with the mouse or your finger, or simply tap a card to send it to the best available spot. Undo takes back a move, and your game in progress is saved, so you can close the page and continue later.

The game keeps score the traditional way. Moving cards to the foundations and revealing hidden tableau cards earns points, pulling a card back from a foundation costs 15, recycling the waste pile costs 100, and every ten seconds on the clock takes away two. Finish in 30 seconds or more and you get a time bonus, plus a shower of confetti. When every card is face up and the stock is empty, an Auto Finish button completes the game for you. Your best score and games won are kept on your device.
howToPlay: Build four foundation piles, one per suit, from Ace up to King. In the tableau, stack cards in descending order with alternating red and black colors; you can move a whole face-up run at once, and only a King (or a run starting with a King) can fill an empty column. Tap or click the stock to deal a card to the waste pile; when the stock is empty, tap it again to turn the waste over. Drag a card or a run of cards onto a valid pile, or tap a card to move it automatically: it goes to its foundation when possible, otherwise to a column where it fits.

controls.action: Move a card or a run of cards
Send it to the best valid spot
Deal a card or recycle the waste

tips: Turn over face-down tableau cards whenever you can: each one is worth 5 points and opens new moves.
Keep an empty column for a King that frees a long pile of hidden cards.
Avoid recycling the stock too often, because each pass through the waste costs 100 points.
Playing a waste card onto the tableau first and then to its foundation earns 15 points instead of 10.

faq.question: Is Classic Solitaire free to play?
faq.answer: Yes. Classic Solitaire is completely free and runs in your browser, with no download or sign-up.

faq.question: Can I play on a phone or tablet?
faq.answer: Yes. The table adapts to any screen in portrait or landscape. Drag cards with your finger, or tap a card to move it to the best available spot.

faq.question: Is my game saved?
faq.answer: Yes. The game in progress, your best score and the number of games won are saved in your browser, so you can close the page and pick up where you left off.

faq.question: How is the score calculated?
faq.answer: It uses standard Klondike scoring: points for foundation moves and revealed cards, penalties for recycling the stock and for time spent, and a time bonus of 700,000 divided by your time in seconds when you win after 30 seconds or more.
